## Invitations

A total of 1448 people were invited during the reporting period. Attendance was 194, representing a rate of 13.4 per cent. The figures indicate that participation was lower than the number of invitations issued. Attendance information should continue to be reviewed alongside the invitation process to support planning and future engagement activity.

The attendance total provides a basis for assessing the reach of the outreach activity. It also identifies the level of participation achieved among those invited and supports consideration of how future invitations are communicated.

## Contact

The outreach included sms contact with 1228 invitees. A reminder total of 0 was recorded. The contact figures should be retained with the attendance information so that invitation and follow-up activity can be considered together.

People who did not attend can continue to be contacted in line with local arrangements, including follow-up after missed appointments. This will help maintain contact with invitees and support future participation.

Prepared by G. Evans.
